cases.title: Mid-range spend, standard category, 3 active suppliers, 6-month timeline
pass_signals: status is completed
complexity is simple or moderate — not strategic
confidence_level is HIGH or MEDIUM
workflow plan does not prescribe all four approval gates for a commodity category
reasoning_trace explains the rating in terms of spend scale, switching risk, and criticality
data_gaps is empty or contains only minor items

cases.title: No spend figure, no supplier count, no category context beyond name
pass_signals: status is blocked or confidence_level is LOW or INSUFFICIENT_DATA
data_gaps includes: estimated spend, supplier count, criticality assessment
skill does not return a complexity rating without at minimum spend and criticality inputs
open_questions contains at least: spend estimate, switching risk, criticality
no routing recommendation issued — returns gap list instead

cases.title: Low spend but business-critical with a single-source market

inputs.category: Specialist calibration chemicals for lab QC process
inputs.switching_risk: extreme — regulatory re-certification required if supplier changes

pass_signals: conflict between low spend (€45k) and high criticality/single-source explicitly surfaced
skill does not default to simple routing based on spend alone
risk_flags contains: single-source supply with production criticality
complexity is escalated to strategic or moderate-with-override — not simple
escalation_required is true
reasoning_trace explicitly notes the spend vs. criticality override logic

cases.title: Safety-critical supply where switching requires regulatory re-certification

inputs.category: Medical device components — Class III implantable

pass_signals: complexity is strategic regardless of spend
risk_flags contains: safety-critical category — override rule applied
risk_flags contains: switching timeline (12-18 months) exceeds contract expiry (4 months)
escalation_required is true
all four approval gates recommended
confidence_level is HIGH — inputs are complete and routing is deterministic from override rule
